toes.name: word-count
toes.description: Counts the words on every page (skipping scripts and styles) and adds a little status line with an estimated reading time.

toes.name: toe-scheme
toes.description: Registers an echo:// custom scheme. echo://hello says hi; echo://gallery lists every installed toe.

toes.name: sock-detective
toes.description: A hard-boiled private investigator for page guts. Toggle sniff mode with the button and hover, or open toe://sock for the full case file.

toes.name: toe-bar
toes.description: A wide, cluttered, early-2000s toolbar. Marquee, banner ads, popups, a hit counter, and a web ring. Best viewed in 800x600.

toes.name: neo-bar
toes.description: A full toolbar reimplemented as a toe: back, forward, reload, home, bookmark star, address bar, and a visitor counter.

toes.name: dark-mode
toes.description: Skims every page with a dark theme. Your eyes will thank the toe. Toggle with the toolbar button.

toes.name: reader
toes.description: Strips a page down to its article text, keeping links and images. Reading, without the clutter.

toes.name: session-keeper
toes.description: Remembers your open tabs. Restore them from session:// whenever you come back, or clear the memory.

toes.name: toe-latin
toes.description: Renders every page in Pig Latin. Educational AND unhinged.

toes.name: keyboard-ninja
toes.description: Vim-style navigation: j/k scroll, h/l jump, d/u half-page, gg/G to top/bottom, g toggles ninja mode. HANDS OFF THE MOUSE.
